title: Express
label: Express
desc: Small Node.js framework for routing, middleware and JSON APIs.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install Express 5 and start a server that answers on port 3000.

snippets.code:
# Create the project and install the framework
mkdir orders-api
cd orders-api
npm init --yes
npm install express

# Run the entry point, restarting it when a file changes
node --watch server.js

sections.title: Routing
sections.description: Map HTTP methods and paths to handlers, then split them into routers.

sections.title: Middleware
sections.description: Run shared logic before handlers, in the order it is registered.

sections.title: Request
sections.description: Read the query string, headers and connection details from the incoming request.

sections.title: Response
sections.description: Shape the reply with status codes, headers, cookies and files.

sections.title: Route Parameters
sections.description: Capture path segments and validate them once before the handler runs.

sections.title: Body Parsing
sections.description: Parse JSON and form payloads, and keep raw bytes when a signature needs them.

sections.title: Static Files
sections.description: Serve files from a folder, with cache rules per URL prefix.

sections.title: Error Handling
sections.description: Turn failures into the right status code with a 404 tail and a four-argument handler.

sections.title: Async Handlers
sections.description: Await data inside handlers; Express 5 forwards a rejected promise to the error handler.

sections.title: Validation
sections.description: Reject bad input before it reaches the database, with reusable rules or schemas.

sections.title: Security
sections.description: Set safe headers, restrict browser origins and cap repeated requests.

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Exercise routes in-process with node:test and supertest, with no port to open.

snippets.code:
# Install the in-process HTTP client, then run every *.test.js file
npm install --save-dev supertest
node --test

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: The failures that show up first: wrong order, duplicate reply and Express 5 wildcards.
